positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Anonymize billing data for security and improve against any potential bias when sampling data
• Analyze and identify using machine learning for any potential clusters to reduce the sample size for an improved testing time
• Implement a model that allows engineers to use in their testing pipeline

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Create a single global endpoint for an API that loans out unused EC2 servers to customers and internal teams for testing or diagnosing problems in their services
• Design a new UI that will serve up the new endpoint with better user experiences such as caching, searching, and error feedback
• Add an extra layer of authentication through HTTP protocols

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Work on the IBM Watson Compare and Comply API, which is used to automate contracts and invoices
• My project compares invoices that were parsed from PDF format and find duplicate invoices based on a certain parameters
• Implement my entity flow script in Scala that allows for fuzzy matching and variant name generation

projects.title: U-Express
projects.description:
• Designed an app that uses LeapMotion (a device that registers hand motion) to express whether one likes a photo or not using swipe motion or circular motion
• Formed as a hackathon project for CalHacks 4.0
• Assembled by using Node.js, Express.js, Bootstrap API, and Heroku server

projects.title: URL-IRL
projects.description:
•	Collaborate with an 8-person team to create an Android application that takes photo of URL to open websites on the phone in their respective application
•	Produced the back-end of the application, using the Google Optical Character Recognition API to parse texts from a photo
•	Edited 5000 lines of codes of Java and XML with 226 commits through 3 months period
